body: A2 to A7 done on the probe build, 17:37 to 18:05. Full notes and screenshots are in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/results/android/e2e/notes.md.U+000AU+000AU+002D A2 PASS: heading, bold, link, list and task save and render with no Markdown symbols. D5 (Hurts): B with nothing selected inserts `****`, and B again after typing strips it, so "bold on, type, bold off" loses the bold (spec C1 literal). D6 (Hurts): after a format button, the Cut/Copy/Paste menu stays over the text while typing, confirmed with real soft-keyboard taps. Links do not open: spec non-goal.U+000AU+002D A3 PASS in the probe: photos insert, card and viewer show them, removal persists. The probe overrides notePhotoPickerProvider (generated PNGs) and reminderSchedulerProvider (silent), so the real gallery picker and reminder notifications must be tested on the plain app.U+000AU+002D A4 PASS: D10 (Hurts), the "…" menu opens behind the keyboard. D11 (Hurts), no Redo control on touch. D12 (Hurts), a long-press with the keyboard hidden opens the keyboard, the sheet shifts one line, and the held finger extends the selection into the next line; typing then deleted "coffee\n- [ ] call". Checkboxes are read-only outside the editor.U+000AU+002D A5 PASS: draft restored after a force-stop and after Home plus kill; discard leaves none; a kill within the 400 ms debounce loses those keystrokes.U+000AU+002D A6 PASS: the mic permission prompt appears on the first tap, record/pause/resume/save work, playback plays, pauses, ends and restarts.U+000AU+002D A7 FAIL, D14 (Blocks): video playback shows no picture, only the striped placeholder, while the position and audio advance. Confirmed by screencap and screenrecord, with the camera preview texture as a positive control. D15 (Hurts): no viewfinder before recording on Android (openSession returns null until start()). D16: disposed CameraController error on save.U+000AU+002D D1 (back exits the app) and D2 (unlabelled gear, + and recorder buttons) are from A1.
